narration: Observe... carefully! Pulling half as hard to lift a heavy load sounds wondrous—until you realize... you are pulling twice as much rope!
Let us reason together. Many believe a movable pulley magically lessens the burden of work—thinking force reduction means energy saved. But nature is far more clever than that!
The mechanical advantage is clear! The effort force is halved... yet the displacement of the rope is doubled. Force multiplied by distance remains constant, satisfying the conservation of energy!
And behold! Pulleys never cheat the cosmos—they merely trade distance for force. Test your mastery in the checkpoint quiz below!
